text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the day where Haru Urara finally starts her training for the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She insists on taking first place. And it shows with just how much enthusiasm she has.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At least, that's what I thought. However…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's you, Trainer! It's a pleasure to start training with you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm the best at doing my best! You have nothing to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm ready to run!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup! Phew… That's one lap down.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: On it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: A butterfly! It's so big and pretty!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh look! It's fluttering off toward the grass over there!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, where are you going! Wait for meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara bolts off. I think to chase after her, but I wonder if this is part of her plan for training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to trust her and wait and see until she comes back…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …But she doesn't! Something must have happened. I have to find her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (She's not here…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Or here…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Or here!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look almost everywhere for her, until…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm beat! Time to take a break!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've found Haru Urara! But she's covered in mud… What happened here?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer! Fancy meeting you here!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you going to play tag with Mr. Fish, too?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask her to explain. It seems that after she chased the butterfly, she found herself by the river and started to play tag with a fish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't really understand, but maybe this is all a part of a unique training regimen of hers?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Actually, I think I found the king of the river! And I almost caught him too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Never mind. She was just goofing off.
choice_data_list: So, how about we get back to training?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? But I already did it, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I did it… Or did I?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: AH! I just saw a huge fish! That must be the river god! Let's go find it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Of course! Getting first place is so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I wanna run a lot, get first place a lot, and have a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I mean, that's why you became my trainer, right? You're gonna help me make that happen!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So I'm gonna try my hardest from now on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that Haru Urara really does want to try her best. As long as she has that mindset, I'm sure she'll reach her dreams of taking first place. But…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ooh! That cloud looks like a carrot! It looks so tasty! Wait for meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …First of all, I need to get her to focus on her training. Then I'll think about what comes next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In any case, Haru Urara's training starts today!
